question: Should OpenClaw accept agent activity/status as a bundled modular-dashboard builtin now, or wait for the broader gateway session-activity contract before landing the widget?
rationale: The issue is coherent feature work paired with an open stacked PR, but automation cannot decide whether sessions.list-derived status is sufficient or whether the stronger gateway activity API must come first.

options.title: Review the linked PR as the first slice
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide whether the ops-widget PR is the right initial agent-status builtin and require its review blockers to be resolved before merge.

options.title: Require gateway activity first
options.body: Keep the dashboard widget request dependent on the broader per-session activity API so the widget does not ship on a narrower status source.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Treat this as roadmap detail under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 only if maintainers explicitly want the tracker to own the remaining work.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as the first slice
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide whether the ops-widget PR is the right initial agent-status builtin and require its review blockers to be resolved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main routing signal for the existing Control UI plugin-tab and session-status surfaces involved in the product/API choice.
